summary_md: **Kajian ([@KajianD65580](https://x.com/KajianD65580/status/2115646931129204810))** (in Chinese) highlights **video-to-game** (lovisdotio), an MIT skill for Claude Code and Codex: feed a gameplay video, the agent breaks it down frame by frame, generates images, 3D and sound on fal, writes a playable Three.js game and playtests it, at about $6 per game per the author.
